scope: CPU-only pinned-source inspection; no GPU test, candidate change, performance claim or run authorization
conclusion: GPU cumulative end metadata can bound persistent scheduled work to local aligned expert rows, independently of static A/D allocation capacity. Installed BF16 API acceptance on SM90 is not proven by generic scheduler support; verify host guards before implementation.

device_contract.metadata: Device int32 vector [num_groups], one physical valid end offset per expert. Not per-row expert IDs and not ordinary cumulative valid counts. Host binding shape/dtype constraints still require verification.
device_contract.recurrence: start[0]=0; end[g]=start[g]+valid_count[g]; start[g+1]=align(end[g],BLOCK_M). Nonnegative counts; end[g]>=start[g], end[g]<=allocation capacity; aligned capacity must cover full scheduled final tile.
device_contract.scheduling: gemm.cuh:108-111 initializes first end;216-236 traverses GPU ends, skips groups with zero blocks, terminates after num_groups. Work tiles=sum_g ceil(valid_count[g]/BLOCK_M)*ceil(N/BLOCK_N), not ceil(capacity/BLOCK_M)*ceil(N/BLOCK_N). Each resident CTA has persistent task iteration. No host count read appears in device scheduler.
device_contract.empty: All-zero ends produce no work; output remains untouched, not guaranteed zero. Explicit consumer validity/masking remains mandatory.
device_contract.precision: Metadata changes schedule only. Raw valid BF16 result, cast-before-global-scale order, unchanged weights and independent reference gates remain required.
device_contract.padding: Last partial tile still executes full SM90 BF16 tile; raw padded values unspecified. Psum eliminates excess capacity tiles, not all alignment waste.
device_contract.guards: Actual chosen BLOCK_M must match physical expert start spacing; metadata with negative values or overlapping/unrounded ends can underflow unsigned arithmetic. Never pass m_indices [-1,...] as psum.

sm90_limit.kernel: sm90_bf16_gemm.cuh:136 instantiates Scheduler with default kEnsureZeroPadding=true. Kernel template lacks ensure-zero-padding parameter and calls no is_computation_valid.
sm90_limit.ensure_zero_padding_false: Not demonstrated on SM90. Scheduler:187-193 effective-M optimization is explicitly swap-A/B and psum only, uses UMMA steps; presence does not prove Hopper host dispatch supports requested flag.
sm90_limit.expected_m_for_psum_layout: Python default None forwarded unchanged to compiled binding; semantics/SM90 restrictions absent in captured host source. Do not assume it bounds work or equals true routing count.

sglang_integration.existing_api: entrypoint.py:162-170 calls BF16 contiguous with only a,b,d,m_indices; existing BF16 wrapper does not expose psum flags.
sglang_integration.gpu_counts: fused_moe_dispatch_index produces valid_tokens_per_expert on GPU. ep_scatter_1 computes starts from cumulative padded counts on GPU and produces per-row m_indices plus src2dst. A separate GPU end vector is feasible without CPU .item()/tolist().
sglang_integration.tail: triton_pad_expert_counts.py rounds counts then adds all_tokens-sum(padded) to final expert. Cumulative padded ends therefore include static tail and defeat desired work reduction. Its comment that DeepGEMM skips -1 rows is false for this exact SM90 BF16 implementation.
sglang_integration.candidate_end_construction: If actual BLOCK_M matches existing scatter physical spacing, GPU ends=expert_start_loc+valid_tokens_per_expert excludes final slack. Added slack affects final expert length, not its start. Verify empty experts and actual block spacing before use.
sglang_integration.alignment_caveat: Query alignment128 is not by itself proof selected BLOCK_M128. If selected BLOCK_M64, existing128-aligned scatter starts may differ from scheduler align(previous_end,64). Need host config guarantee or construct scatter at verified selected alignment; do not guess.
sglang_integration.deepep_v2: Existing ep_scatter_from_psum/fill_m_indices_from_psum demonstrate GPU cumulative metadata consumers, but current BF16 runner converts to full m_indices; not evidence direct backend psum admission.

roi.engineering_prior: With topk8 and EP8 roughly uniform routing, allocation based on global M*8 may greatly exceed local useful assignments ~M. Eliminating tail can recover roughly8x GEMM work at large M before expert alignment overhead, not8x end-to-end speedup.
roi.qualification: Routing skew,32 local expert padding, fixed launch, scatter, conversion, other operators and memory capacity change actual ratio. Baseline timing and v3 backend smoke do not measure psum benefit.
